description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Parasankulam (Block 01) Vavuniya D/S Division, Vavuniya District - Cad. Map No. 950011
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels in various villages in Vavuniya District. It involves land ownership determination, cadastral mapping, and title settlement procedures under the Registration of Title Act, which falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
